title: Late Fee Reduction for Households with Several Children in Creek Kids Club
content:
**Reduction.** Under the multi-program household schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a late fee on a Pre-K tuition account is reduced for a household whose children are enrolled in the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program. The count is the household's Creek Kids Club enrollments in status active; each such enrollment covers one child.

| Children of the household holding a Creek Kids Club enrollment in status active | Taken off the late fee |
|---|---|
| three or more | 10.00 |
| exactly two | 5.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

## Reading the household's Creek Kids Club records (hypothetical household)

| Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollments of the household | Counted |
|---|---|
| child A, Before-School Care (5 Days), status active | yes |
| child B, Before & After-School Care (5 Days), status active | yes |
| child C, After-School Care (2 Days), status active | yes |
| child D, a registration on the waitlist | no: not active |

Three children counted: 10.00 is taken off the late fee. Had child C's enrollment not been active, two would be counted and 5.00 taken off.
